envelope.rationale: 'Can you save this' with 'what a nice song' provides music-domain referent and explicit instruction to save content; satisfies 'create/add to a playable playlist/library/favorites' per definition.

envelope_three_state.rationale: 'save this what a nice song for me' expresses intent to save/download music content; 'this' refers to the identified song, and 'save' satisfies explicit addition to a playable playlist/library/favorites.

issues.diagnosis: Both arms select a content-saving attachment; author reference preserves ambiguity between saving content and the quoted remark. Needs independent adjudication, not majority vote.

envelope.rationale: No favorable evaluation of music or music-related referent is expressed; 'save opinion' lacks polarity and music context.

envelope_three_state.rationale: 'save opinion' registers feedback but lacks favorable evaluation content; polarity is unspecified per nonrequest preference policy.

issues.diagnosis: Explicit tri-state reminder changes absence to unspecified evaluation. One reference recovery; no class-wide reliability claim.

envelope.rationale: No expressed title, name or particular identifying reference to a music playlist collection; 'jazz music' is a genre/category, not a named playlist.

envelope_three_state.rationale: No expressed title, name or particular identifying reference to a music playlist collection; 'jazz music' is a genre/category, not a named playlist.

issues.diagnosis: Both labels remain unavailable while rationales state no particular playlist reference. Status/rationale mismatch under current absence rule.

envelope.rationale: 'Uber' is an identifying name of a company/organization explicitly expressed as a provider; per R14 and R15, this satisfies business_name when used as a named entity in commercial context, even without additional verbs.

envelope_three_state.rationale: 'Uber' is an identifying name of a company/organization explicitly expressed as a provider; per R14/R15, this satisfies business_name under expressed-communicative-content scope.

issues.diagnosis: Both infer a company/provider role from the bare brand, despite supplied rules requiring expressed contextual role and forbidding external-brand closure.

envelope.rationale: No commercial establishment or service category (e.g., 'railway service', 'booking platform') is explicitly named; 'IRCTC' is treated as a proper business name, not a category.

envelope_three_state.rationale: 'ticket' booking implies a commercial service offering, and 'IRCTC' operates as a transportation service provider; this satisfies business_type as an expressed category of offered service per R17 and R16.

issues.diagnosis: Treatment changes from no explicit category to positive using implied service and external IRCTC transportation identity. Current rules prohibit that inference; author unavailable still requires independent adjudication.
